title: Lior and the Asset
author: Jude Delacroix
blurb: Marguerite Okafor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
